reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by PrimeReact (https://primereact.dev/).
Technology stack: react, typescript, javascript, css.
Component specification: 最后开 Button。import 路径和 Reject/Accept 预览都在。

Visual details from source observation: primereact.org 跳到 primereact.dev。首页 Premium UI Suite for React，徽章 primereact@11.1.0，顶栏 Next Chapter Begins。Components 页 Form 27 项，AutoComplete 到 DatePicker。Button 页 import { Button } from '@primereact/ui/button'，Reject/Accept 现场预览。本条是 React 入口，不含 PrimeVue。v11 走 PrimeUI：Community 免费但有营收/人数门槛，Commercial 含 Blocks 与主题工具；10.x 仍为 MIT。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
